finding.claim: Blog desktop loses roughly 32px below header
finding.disposition: Not reproduced; rejected against primary images
finding.evidence: Parent reopened native and approved 1440px frames. Blog home intro ink begins at y126 in both; lead image top is y195 in both. Article title begins at y212 in both and audio panel at y483. Centering differs by about 8px because the reference includes a classic scrollbar; there is no vertical compression.

otherFindings: No other material new visual defects reported. Approved header coverage and existing Visual Guide overlap retained. Backend unavailable and lazy-image full-page capture states do not change source geometry.
limits: Headless Chromium, no physical-phone or authenticated Analytics review.

codeReviewFixes.issue: Unlisted posts have no public theme variables
codeReviewFixes.fix: Shared header has safe light-surface fallbacks. Footer inherits light text from its dark page instead of restoring dark-on-dark legacy colors.
codeReviewFixes.verification: Rendered the actual built private template through a neutral local address at desktop and phone widths. Exported only shared navigation crops. Background, keyboard outline and footer contrast checks passed without exposing the private article or access path.
